title: Concrete Calculator
description: Calculate cubic yards of concrete for any slab, plus how many 60 lb or 80 lb bags that equals.
howto: Enter the slab length and width in feet.
Enter the thickness in inches (4 is standard for patios).
Read the cubic yards to order and the equivalent bag count.

faqs.a: Volume in cubic feet (length × width × thickness in feet) divided by 27. One cubic yard = 27 cubic feet.

faqs.q: How much does an 80 lb bag of concrete make?
faqs.a: About 0.6 cubic feet of mixed concrete. A 60 lb bag makes about 0.45 cubic feet.

faqs.q: Should I add extra for waste?
faqs.a: Yes. The bag counts include a 10% waste allowance; for ready-mix, order the rounded-up yardage shown.
